problem_statement: The Connection Manager's connectivity API needs an interface idle (inactivity) timeout. Users must be able to set and query an idle timeout for an interface that is bound to a connectivity implementation, in seconds, and to disable it with CONN_MGR_IF_NO_TIMEOUT. Setting and getting an idle timeout on a bound interface must succeed and reflect the configured value; for an interface that is not bound to any connectivity implementation, setting the idle timeout must fail with -ENOTSUP and getting it must return CONN_MGR_IF_NO_TIMEOUT. An interface that stays active should refresh the timer so it is not disconnected while in use, and a configured idle timeout should cause the interface to be disconnected once it goes inactive, treated as an unintentional connection loss for purposes of connection persistence.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/net/conn_mgr_conn -s tests/net/conn_mgr_conn/net.conn_mgr.conn -s net.conn_mgr.conn -O twister-out --no-clean -W
